# FRAMECAD

> > FRAMECAD provides end-to-end light gauge steel (LGS) and cold-formed steel (CFS) construction technology, including the Mobile Factory system for rapid deployment, roll-forming machinery, and DfMA software solutions.

FRAMECAD specializes in light steel frame construction systems that enable both onsite and offsite prefabrication. The company serves diverse markets from residential ADUs to disaster relief, with notable deployments including US Navy humanitarian missions and projects across Australia, USA, and Latin America.

## Key Topics

- Light Gauge Steel (LGS)
- Cold-Formed Steel (CFS)
- FRAMECAD Mobile Factory
- Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DfMA)
- Prefabrication and modular construction
- Roll-forming technology
- Steel framing systems
- Portable manufacturing
- Disaster relief construction
- Construction efficiency
- Offsite construction
- FRAMECAD Structure software
- Light Steel Frame (LSF/LGSF)
- Steel coil handling
